ingest.notes: Substantially better ingest than the 12:06 UTC primary fire (which reported 14 ok / 8 fail). This retry reached 25 feeds via curl with a browser UA — including Reuters (GN), AP News (GN), Bloomberg (GN), Economist (GN), DW (GN), Semafor (GN), Guardian (GN), Axios (GN), Ars Technica (GN), Wired (GN), Washington Examiner (GN), CSM (GN), CNBC Top/Markets, Fox News, and RealClearPolitics. Persistent failures: NPR (all four feeds 403 Akamai/Edgesuite), Politico (403), The Verge (403), FT Home (403), all four WSJ direct feeds parsing OK but serving stale January 2025 content via the egress proxy summarizer (third consecutive run with this pattern; recommend switching to Bloomberg/Economist (GN) as mandate proxies), ProPublica (no fresh items in 36h), and all four NYT (GN) feeds returning valid XML with an empty <channel> (third consecutive day; same outcome as 2026-05-24 and 2026-05-25 primary). Note: Google News redirector RSS gives item titles+links but the redirector URLs themselves resolve to a JS-rendered Google News interstitial that does not yield the underlying article body — useful for cluster discovery and mandate-signal, useless for body fetch.

cluster.manual_curation: Hand-curated clusters across 25 successful feeds. Final selection covers Iran deal walk-back (Politics, lead), Iran-peace markets rally (Markets — Nikkei 65k record, Brent below $100, Bund yields at May-8 low), Pope Leo XIV first encyclical 'Magnifica Humanitas' on AI (World), Huawei LogicFolding chip-design claim (Tech), and Garden Grove tank crack lowering BLEVE risk (Health). Skipped this round despite candidate scores: Turkey CHP raid (PBS body found, but only single body-tier source within 36h direct-URL window), Russia Oreshnik Kyiv strike (body sources all blocked — BBC, Guardian, DW direct all 403; CBS/NBC/PBS had no standalone Russia piece in this run), Pakistan train suicide bombing (Fox + AJ analytical only, missing dedicated reportage in fetchable sources), White House gunman ID (covered yesterday slot 2 in the primary fire's partial — dedupe penalty 0.5; replaced by the stronger Markets and Pope clusters that the primary had to skip).

research.notes: Direct fetch routes that worked this run (curl + browser UA): PBS NewsHour, CBS News, NBC News (incl. today.com video pages), Al Jazeera direct article URLs, CNBC Top/Markets direct, Fox News direct. RealClearPolitics returned a 'Please enable JS and disable any ad blocker' interstitial via curl — dropped. BBC bbc.com article pages still 403 at the egress layer. WebFetch was not the primary route this run; curl proved sufficient and faster. The major unlock vs. the 12:06 UTC primary fire was correctly mapping the fetched RSS to feed names — the primary failed to recognize CNBC, Bloomberg (GN), and several other feeds were reachable, which is what left it at 4/5 slots.
